url.label: xDrip sync URL
url.description: Base URL of your xdrip-sync server, e.g. http://host:8080

token.label: Read token (optional)
token.description: Leave empty if reads are open (XD_OPEN_READS=true). Create one with `xdrip-sync token create`.

notify_crossings.label: Notify when a reading crosses a threshold

ui.error_timeout: xdrip-sync unreachable — check the URL and try refreshing.
ui.error_parse: Could not parse the xdrip-sync response.
